_comment: F32#1 / HOMESTEAD §5.2: four canonical RD-33 refining outputs. This file is not loaded into the ordinary crafting catalogue yet. F31 owns the reachable Forge, personal attachment-tier validation and tap-start player path; foundation owns each unit's atomic material debit/output receipt. Provisional starting costs remain subject to F47's supply/solvency ledger.
_comment_attachment_bootstrap: F32/F31 source dependency correction: each tier attachment costs two of its own refined ingot, so raw-to-ingot refinement cannot require that same attachment. These four basic refining recipes require the actual built Forge and the actor's applicable personal learned/unlocked recipe eligibility. required_attachment_tier is explicitly zero; tier metadata stays 1–4. No previous-tier gate is invented. Gear, upgrades and all other station tier gates retain their owning contracts. This unregistered table grants guests no recipe, tier, blueprint or attachment rights.

authority_contract.recipe_eligibility: Canonical host character recipe/unlock state where the owning recipe contract requires it; clients supply no learned flag or eligibility baseline.
authority_contract.transaction: Each completed manual unit atomically debits canonical raw costs, grants one output and records one stable-character receipt at the actual host-world Forge, or changes nothing.
authority_contract.registration: Inactive source proposals only; F31/foundation own registration, station/character authentication and durable transaction composition.
